item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena's father buys a new battery for the torch used at their home in Jaipur. The shopkeeper tells them that this battery can be connected to a charger again and again, so it can be used for many months instead of being thrown away after it is used up once.
Which statement correctly classifies this battery?

options.A: It is a single-use cell because all batteries stop working after some time.
options.B: It is a rechargeable cell because it can be recharged and reused many times.
options.C: It is a single-use cell because it is used inside a torch.
options.D: It is a rechargeable cell because it is sold in a shop and not made at home.
